title: The Haunted Mansion (2003 film) — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
The honest version of The Haunted Mansion (2003 film) starts by giving up the comforting part. The Haunted Mansion is a 2003 American supernatural horror comedy film directed by Rob Minkoff and written by David Berenbaum. Loosely based on the Disneyland attraction of the same name, the film stars Eddie Murphy as a realtor who, along with his family, becomes trapped in the titular building.

Every serious account of The Haunted Mansion (2003 film) eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Audiences polled by CinemaScore gave the film an average grade of "B" on an A+ to F scale. I expected an inane series of nonstop action sequences, but what I got was a fairly intriguing story and an actual plot that is actually resolved.
